protocol.unchanged: Identical first prompt; same feedback construction on each model own candidate, max 2 calls, 15000 tokens, 2048 output tokens, 600s, dual validation and rollback
protocol.limits: Known development tasks, one run; body-only edits cannot change signatures/docstrings; system schema and small block catalog change with protocol
protocol.order: Alternating arm order; fresh independent model requests

offline.scope: Only the complete first edit recoverable from a truncated response; no missing code inferred or applied
